purpose: Recalculate proposal-only P0 action posture after a new completed close while preserving human confirmation and execution boundaries.

gates.completed_close: Latest completed close must be later than the research baseline close.
gates.position_continuity: User-confirmed transaction continuity must extend through the latest completed close.
gates.weight_band: Current Simulation weight is compared with the governed revised band.
gates.expected_return: Base-case expected return is recalculated from the latest completed close and compared with a 15% hurdle.
gates.human_decision: Any add or trim result is a proposal pending user approval, never an automatic position change.
gates.execution: No order can be produced or executed; trade_authority remains NONE.

operating_schedule.reason: Run after the existing Portfolio Current refresh and official fund-NAV availability window.
